# Recorded Stalwart responses

Generated by `tests/integration/stalwart.py --record` against **Stalwart 1.0.3**
with disposable `alice@example.test`, `bob@example.test` and `team@example.test`
accounts. These are actual authenticated PROPFIND response bodies, not hand-written
predictions of group ACL behavior. No request credentials or headers are recorded.

Both assisted discovery enabled and disabled are covered. Alice is a member of
Team. BobShared grants DAV read privilege to Team; BobDirect grants it to Alice.
The group-share XML was requested as Alice, confirming the effective permission.
The home JSON maps advertised home hrefs to their Depth:1 XML responses. Principal
XML records the advertised home sets. Paths are fixture-only and deliberately
remain relative, so no listening port or production hostname is captured.

These recordings are protocol regression tests. They supplement, and do not
replace, the live Thunderbird/Stalwart acceptance test. No Stalwart source is
included in these data files.
